segments.title: CAM-00 • HIGH BASALT SHELF TOWER & ATC CONTROL ROOM
segments.subtitle: This is GOR-9. This is GOR-9 [ding-ding] Galactic Outpost Radio, broadcasting from the High Basalt Shelf Tower on Asteroid 3-5-1, 42,100 AU out in Oort Cloud Sector 9. 14,285 kHz USB. 0400 Galactic Coordinated.

segments.title: CONSOLE 1 • VAN ALLEN VA-4 • OORT PROPAGATION & SPACE WEATHER
segments.subtitle: On the Van Allen VA-4 Propagation and Power Console—brought to you by Van Allen and Sons Switchgear: Comet K-4's ion tail opens a 24 MHz skip corridor to the Jovian moons; a 60 kV triboelectric dust squall at Relay KZ9-Omega arcs across the #4 Belt-Master marzelvane bushing (SINPO 2-3-2-2-2).

segments.title: CONSOLE 1B • VAN ALLEN VA-4 • 50 kW DILITHIUM POWER BUS
segments.subtitle: On the Dilithium Bus: Grade-B Dilithium pellets +4% on the Ceres Exchange (Quarry 44-K slowdown). With the Van Allen Ring-Bake corona de-icer pulling +4.5 kW, Reactor #2 steps down to 12 kW after midnight (plug in Van Allen Cryo-Toast foot-warmers). Tender held at Quarantine Buoy 12 ('fermented brine tubers').

segments.title: CONSOLE 2 • HAUSER DYNAMICS MK-IV • GALAXY ATLAS & DECODER

sub_views.label: P-02 • 3,890 kHz CW • TITAN-MINOR BUOY N-24
sub_views.subtitle: Turning to the Hauser Dynamics MK-IV Receiver: Preset Two—Titan-Minor, 3,890 kHz. Hydrographic Buoy N-24 is transmitting methane tide telemetry, though migratory silt-striders rubbing against the guy-wires just detuned the whip antenna by 18 Hz. eQSL #0882 logged.

sub_views.label: P-01 • 11,410 kHz AM • CALLISTO DOME-4 'RADIO CORRUGATED'
sub_views.subtitle: Preset One—Callisto Dome Four, 11,410 kHz. Unlicensed noodle-market broadcaster Radio Corrugated, peaking at S9+10 right as their engineer hit the rooftop dipole with a blowtorch.

sub_views.label: P-03 • 1,420.405 MHz • EXTRAGALACTIC M-33 DRIFT BUOY [ALG-02]
sub_views.subtitle: Preset Three—extragalactic, 1,420 MHz on the hydrogen line toward M-33. No video carrier—just a relativistic Doppler Lissajous on the spectrum scan. Translation Algorithm 02 decodes Buoy M-33-771: still issuing small-craft advisories for an ammonia sea that evaporated during the Ming Dynasty.

sub_views.label: P-04 • 6,925 kHz USB • TROJAN OCTAL NUMBERS STATION [ALG-03]
sub_views.subtitle: And on Preset Four, 6,925 kHz in the Jupiter Trojans: an encrypted base-8 numbers station where Algorithm 03 just decoded six metric tons of pork-chive dumpling wrappers—plus an octal shift key of 13 for those tracking the sector cipher in the station log.

segments.title: CONSOLE 3 BOGEY-9 TRAIL-CAM & CONSOLE 4 VAN ALLEN ED-9 EUCLIDEAN DETECTOR

steps.subtitle: Bogey-9 Perimeter Trail-Cam (03:41 GCT): Trail-Cam One on the Acheron North Rim triggered an 8-frame burst on a mirror-chrome cylinder drifting at 14 m/s before executing a 90° vertical snap-turn at 140g with zero thruster plume (blamed on a vented Mess Hall thermos flask).

Van Allen ED-9 Euclidean Detector—searching for geometric intelligence across the universe: our 12-tube Hough Transform correlator locked onto a single 99.998% synthetic signature in Callisto-South Brine Evaporation Vat 19: the Unsuspecting Parallelogram.

Under inspection-beam sweep Frame 7, four salt-crust ridges form parallelogram ABDC (Euclid I.34 / G.47): opposite sides AB || CD and AC || BD hold parallel to 0.0002 arcsec, while diameter BC bisects the sludge into two congruent triangles.

Seven minutes after our Van Allen detector logged the Proposition 34 proof, the Callisto Water Board scrubbed the archive and blamed a motorized mud-rake that lost a cotter pin. That is one remarkably well-educated mud-rake, folks.

segments.title: COMING NEXT, VAN ALLEN UNDERWRITER & CAM-00D SIGN-OFF
segments.subtitle: On the next broadcast: an uninspected Dilithium barge rendezvous in the tail of Comet K-Four, and a suspected rhombus aboard a bulk ice-hauler. This broadcast is underwritten by Van Allen and Sons Switchgear—from radiation belts to reactor beds, if it arcs, we clamp it. From Asteroid 3-5-1 in Oort Cloud Sector 9, this is GOR-9—your eye to the cosmos, ear to the vacuum.
